construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
Initial Study (August 2023) lists the applicant as TTLC Morgan Hill - Edes, LLC, 12647 Alcosta Boulevard, Suite 470, San Ramon. The True Life Companies' website gives the same office address.

Initial Study: seven three-story buildings of about 2,390 sq ft each, three townhomes per building; three street parking spaces on Edes Court and four bicycle spaces; buildings raised on about two feet of fill above the FEMA flood zone.
City project page status: Processing Building Permits. Design Permit approved 2023-09-07 (Approval Certificate 23-017); Planning Commission Resolution 23-11 (2023-09-12).
State report 2023 project name: Edes - Alcini (TTLC MH LLC); 5 other density bonus incentives (development standards modification).
